api.unauthorized: That wallet service is reachable, but it rejected the access token. Copy the token from the Host screen of the computer running it.
api.refusedApiRequest: {{url}} is reachable but refused the wallet API request ({{reason}}).
api.couldNotReach: Could not reach a wallet service. Tried {{failures}}
api.httpsOnly: The web wallet can connect only to an HTTPS wallet service. Use an HTTPS URL, an .onion address over Tor, or the installed desktop/mobile app for a plain HTTP LAN connection.
api.enterValidHttpsUrl: Enter a valid HTTPS wallet-service URL.
api.cannotReachTor: Cannot reach the Tor wallet service. ({{detail}})
api.cannotReachEmbedded: Cannot reach the embedded wallet engine. ({{detail}})
api.notResponding: The wallet service is not responding (timed out).
api.invalidResponse: The wallet service returned an invalid response ({{status}}).

noncustodial.fragmentedDefault: This payment needs more notes than one transaction can spend.
noncustodial.waitingPrevious: Waiting for the previous payment to finish preparing…
noncustodial.amountChanged: The daemon changed the requested amount. Refusing to sign.
noncustodial.couldNotPrepareComplete: The wallet service could not prepare the complete amount in one transaction.
noncustodial.feeAboveLimit: The daemon asked for a fee of {{fee}} ZKAS — above the {{max}} ZKAS this wallet allows. Refusing to sign.
noncustodial.partialSent: Sent {{sent}} ZKAS in {{n}} transactions, but {{owed}} ZKAS could not be sent: this wallet's balance is split across too many small notes. Consolidate the wallet and send the rest.
noncustodial.nothingSent: Nothing was sent. This wallet has too many small notes for that amount to fit in one transaction.
noncustodial.notEnoughToConsolidate: There is not enough spendable balance to consolidate safely.
noncustodial.unsafeConsolidation: The wallet service returned an unsafe consolidation.
noncustodial.noSpendableToSplit: No spendable note is available to split right now. Wait for recent funds to mature (about 10 minutes), then try again.
noncustodial.fewerThanThree: Fewer than three notes are spendable right now, so consolidating would not reduce the wallet's note count.

status.behindDetail_one: You can send now — everything a payment needs is already in view. The wallet is still reading the newest {{n}} block, so anything that arrived in them is not counted yet.
status.behindDetail_other: You can send now — everything a payment needs is already in view. The wallet is still reading the newest {{n}} blocks, so anything that arrived in them is not counted yet.
status.behindDetailBare: You can send now — everything a payment needs is already in view. The wallet is still reading the newest blocks, so anything that arrived in them is not counted yet.
status.offlineDetail: Your coins are safe on the chain. The wallet will reconnect on its own.
status.openingDetail: Loading your wallet. This usually takes a few seconds.
status.readyToPayLabel: Ready to pay · still catching up
status.settingUpDetail: Reading the chain to find the coins that belong to you. The amount below is what it has found so far — it is not your final balance yet.
status.catchingUpDetail: Checking the chain for new payments. Your balance is up to date as of the last check.
status.finishingDetail: Your balance is up to date. The wallet is doing the last of its bookkeeping before it can pay — a few seconds.
status.warmingCountedDetail: Your balance is up to date. The wallet is locating your coins in the chain ({{pct}}%) — done once, never again; later payments take seconds.
status.warmingCountedDetailWaited: Your balance is up to date. The wallet is locating your coins in the chain ({{pct}}%) ({{waited}} so far) — done once, never again; later payments take seconds.
status.warmingDetail: Your balance is up to date. The wallet is getting ready to pay — the first payment is the slow one, later ones take seconds.
status.warmingDetailWaited: Your balance is up to date. The wallet is getting ready to pay ({{waited}} so far) — the first payment is the slow one, later ones take seconds.
status.readyDetail: Your balance is up to date.
